method:
Record one command-earned Coastward outing through production UI and real RAF.

The only imported source is the labelled initial expedition kit. Crossing,
acceptance, walking, three records, explicit payment and free return use the
ordinary UI. RPG workspaces pause normally while read; movement never advances
artificial time. Time, quality and camera setup are labelled presentation only.
This records playable progression, not human pacing or the complete Earth world.
presentation_setup: Camera framing only; V exchanges actual modes

ui_readings.name: Declared travel and first payout terms
ui_readings.text:
Broader Earth foundation · provisional local geography
Earth · Coastward Road

A long channel bridge opens onto woodland lanes, working fields and a small roadside settlement. Coastward Road is a provisional extension; Hearthwater and its people retain their existing places and history.

Return to Firstlight: available at any time, free. Reopening or switching characters resumes your saved home checkpoint, retaining accepted work. Crossing makes no allegiance, class or main-story choice.

OPTIONAL LOCAL WORK
Water, fields and the evening load

Merren · field steward keeps this work. Collect Oren’s initial expedition kit before accepting; no campaign chapter is required.

Check the field-water catch
Pack the evening produce load
Register the named load

Declared payout: 28 XP · 12 sunmarks · 2 ore. First completion also leaves a modest work record at the local bench. Equipment remains your choice.

Optional creatures occupy side ground; the three work objectives have a clear route around them.

Reloads retain accepted objectives and claim history. Reopening resumes at your Firstlight checkpoint. Full reward pouches leave completed work ready for retry.

Bring useful progress home

Use sunmarks and ore at Oren’s workbench. The item guide compares blade and bow projects with your current equipment before you choose what to pursue.

Inspect item & recipe guide
Read crossing terms
All five roads

V exchanges third person and your diorama. R resets the current view. These are opening regions; the distant landscape and later capitals remain beyond the current route.
